## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); confirms money rotating across Materials, Tech, Real Estate and Industrials rather than a market-wide risk-off.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Real Estate leads with CCI RECOVERY (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) and sector 1W +3.94% (10 stocks). Materials strong with NEM RECOVERY (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) and FCX RECOVERY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%). Technology showing strength via INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) and AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy weak with XOM CORRECTION (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +7.26%) and CVX CORRECTION (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%) and sector 1W -3.14%. Consumer Discretionary lagging with NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) and GM BELOW TREND (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.49%). Communication is mixed/flat with TMUS BELOW TREND (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -8.33%) and NFLX RECOVERY (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +0.00%).

Top 5: NEM RECOVERY (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%), FCX RECOVERY (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%), CCI RECOVERY (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%), BA RECOVERY (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CSCO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -1.76%), ISRG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -9.80%), GM BELOW TREND (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.49%), CVX CORRECTION (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%), PSX CORRECTION (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.98%). Weakness concentrated in Energy and select cyclical Consumer names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY. Major divergence present across large-caps (many have 1W up vs 1M down) — treat as tactical, not a broad regime flip.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed rotation within Tech: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +5.29% | 1M: -2.36%), META RECOVERY (1W: +4.92% | 1M: -13.89%). Sector 1W +2.18% (24 stocks) — internal rotation within Tech leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials steady: JPM RECOVERY (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -1.60%) while V BELOW TREND (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -6.14%) and MA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -5.64%). Sector 1W +1.65% (20 stocks) — selective strength, not uniform.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing selective upside on catalysts: LLY RECOVERY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +6.39%), ISRG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -9.80%). Sector 1W +1.03% (17 stocks) — catalyst-driven moves dominate.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Materials and Real Estate leaders and selective Tech names showing confirmed 1M strength (INTC, AMD) while reducing exposure to the weakest Energy and erratic Consumer Discretionary names (NKE, GM). Style mixed / no clear leadership; monitor the major divergence across megacaps before enlarging core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%), LLY RECOVERY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%), NEM RECOVERY (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%). BEARISH: NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%), XOM CORRECTION (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +7.26%), CVX CORRECTION (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (1W +3.07%) and Real Estate (1W +3.94%) — breadth driving rotation. BEARISH: Energy (1W -3.14%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W -1.47%) — watch for continued underperformance.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%): close above last week’s high would confirm sustained recovery. AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.51%): failure to hold recent intraday support risks broader tech pullback. JPM RECOVERY (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -1.60%): weekly breakout would confirm financials participation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+85): FDA approval for oral obesity pill; price confirming (LLY RECOVERY 1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) — sentiment and price aligned. BA (+55): Pentagon demand for missile output; BA RECOVERY (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%) — news confirming recent momentum. KHC (+55): turnaround narrative; KHC RECOVERY (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -3.61%) — sentiment and short-term bounce aligned.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
NKE (-50): intentional inventory clearance headline; NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) — sentiment confirmed. NFLX (-50): Italian court ruling negative yet price is RECOVERY (1W: +5.72% | 1M: +0.00%) — sentiment/price divergence to monitor. ADBE (-60): notable negative AI commoditization headline (no detailed 1W/1M in this feed) — watch for follow-through if price data weakens.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, style mixed / no clear leadership as money shifts across Materials, Real Estate and pockets of Tech; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%), NEM RECOVERY (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) and LLY RECOVERY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among large caps (many 1W up vs 1M down) and event-driven sentiment (LLY, BA, NKE) that could trigger tactical rotations.
